## Install

**Windows** (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://github.com/alexcrisan1611/skills-sync/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Linux / macOS**:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/alexcrisan1611/skills-sync/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

The installer lists the `skills` folders on your computer and asks which one holds your skills and which should get links to them. Archives for manual install are below; check them against `SHA256SUMS`.
